newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture rated 3 percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, 9 percent poor, 26 percent fair, 47 percent good and 15 percent excellent.
The department pegged 3 percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 11 percent poor, 31 percent fair, 44 percent good and 11 percent excellent.
USDA said 83 percent of the spring wheat crop had been harvested versus 69 percent a week ago and the five-year average of 69 percent.
USDA pegged 4 percent of the cotton crop in very poor condition, 10 percent poor, 29 percent fair, 44 percent good and 13 percent excellent.
The department said 11 percent of the corn crop was mature versus the five-year average of 23 percent.
It said 8 percent of the soybean crop was dropping leaves, compared to 3 percent last week and versus the five-year average of 14 percent. -- Washington Commodities Desk (202) 898-8394
